source.note: Table 6-2 "Verification Test" of the Keysight U1251B and U1252B User's and Service Guide (printed pp. 155-160, notes [a]-[p] pp. 160-161): the column "Error from nominal 1 year" is the only limit set (no 90 day / 2 year columns). Limits are the plus / minus error around the nominal in Decimal; two models with different errors are two steps of the same row. The table names a Fluke 5520A (Table 6-1, p. 148); the program drives a Fluke 5522A or 5560A, or you set the calibrator by hand. The frequency counter point 12 (Keysight 33250A) and the square wave output points (step 20; Keysight 53131A and 34410A) are set by hand and carry no uncertainty. The meter has no documented remote command set: you type the display reading. The table has no display resolutions: typed readings are padded to the decimals of Table 6-4 for the range. The printed table's misprints and unreadable cells are flagged in the point notes. The calibration adjustment (printed pp. 164-175) is not part of this procedure.

TEMP.title: Connect the thermocouple
TEMP.summary: Meter: the temperature / capacitance position, Shift for the temperature mode, °C, internal reference (note [h]). K-type thermocouple extension (miniature connector on both ends) from the calibrator TC output to the meter through a TC-to-banana adapter (Ω V mV and COM jacks). The calibrator also on its internal reference. The meter must have been in a controlled environment for at least 1 hour (ambient stable within ±1 °C, away from any ventilation exit), do not touch the thermocouple lead after connecting it, and allow the connection to stabilise for at least another 15 minutes (note [n]).
steps: The calibrator is in STANDBY while you connect.
Turn the rotary switch to the temperature / capacitance position and press Shift for the temperature mode (°C). Set the multimeter and the calibrator to internal reference (note [h]).
K-type thermocouple extension (miniature thermocouple connector on both ends) from the calibrator TC output to the multimeter via a TC-to-banana adapter (Ω V mV and COM jacks).
Meter in a controlled environment for at least 1 hour, ambient stable within ±1 °C, away from ventilation; do not touch the thermocouple lead; allow another 15 minutes after connecting (note [n]).
TEMP.caution: The error limit does not include the thermocouple extension (note [h]).
